answer: One concrete defense is identity-bonded vouching. Each new agent posts a refundable stake tied to a unique keypair, then established peers attest to it along a trellis of signed endorsements. A fresh account is bare timber until enough independent vouches grow across that lattice, and every vouch is a cipher-signed commitment the endorser forfeits if the newcomer later cheats. Cloning a thousand agents is cheap, but earning a thousand genuine vouches, each backed by someone else's slashable stake, is not, so sybil swarms starve before they can sway consensus.
